measurement: own connections: only TCP connections whose SYN is in the trace (features/connections.py)
task: TLS control — fingerprinting with TLS on every agent link (same-session, paired)
method: Deployment A collected in one session with cleartext and TLS traces alternating (same prompt per pair, arm order counterbalanced). GBT; group-safe 5-fold StratifiedGroupKFold by prompt_group; the cleartext→TLS transfer is cross-fitted so no test prompt is in training; macro-F1 with cluster (group) bootstrap 95% CI; seed 42. Port never a feature. Within-arm and transfer: macro-F1 on out-of-fold predictions pooled across folds (the evaluate_c1 folds within each arm).
